latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the geometric hull calculator for 2D point sets.

- Supports convex hull, concave hull (using concave-hull or alphashape), and minimum bounding rectangle (MBR) calculations.
- Provides methods for visualization with both OpenCV and matplotlib.
- Allows optional point filtering based on configurable radius.
- Includes functionality to generate random test point sets.
- Supports handling of both single and multiple polygons for concave hull results.
